key_insight: KANs can predict airfoil pressure distributions well, but in this study they were slightly behind a well-tuned MLP and below a GNN in top accuracy.
engineering_relevance: For aerodynamic surrogate modelling, KANs offer a compact and potentially faster-training alternative, but they are not yet the clear performance leader for practical design workflows.
method: Compared KANs, MLPs, and GNNs on subsonic and transonic airfoil pressure prediction.
Evaluated generalization across Mach number and angle of attack.
Assessed both prediction quality and model complexity/training cost.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that KANs interpolated across Mach numbers and angles of attack, but their performance was marginally inferior to an optimally trained MLP and bested by a GNN with longer training.
watch_item: KAN training was unstable and highly sensitive to hyperparameter tuning, so robust optimization is critical before deployment.
paper_title: Kolmogorov Arnold networks (KAN) for aerodynamic prediction: a comparison with MLPs and GNNs
